drivingQuestion: Does the mishna's requirement of reclining apply to wine as well as to bread?
outcomeNote: The Rav–Rabbi Yoḥanan dispute is recorded without resolution; a variant version and an objection follow in the next unit.

segments.he: הֵסַבּוּ, אֶחָד מְבָרֵךְ. אָמַר רַב: לֹא שָׁנוּ אֶלָּא פַּת דְּבָעֵי הֲסִבָּה, אֲבָל יַיִן לָא בָּעֵי הֲסִבָּה. וְרַבִּי יוֹחָנָן אָמַר: אֲפִילּוּ יַיִן נָמֵי בָּעֵי הֲסִבָּה.
segments.en: We learned in the mishna: «If they were reclined, one recites a blessing» on behalf of them all. «Rav said: This» halakha «was only taught» with regard to «bread that» it «requires reclining» to enable one to recite a blessing on behalf of them all. «However, wine does not require reclining. And Rabbi Yoḥanan said: Even wine requires reclining as well.»
